reproduce_first.note: The ask requests a new feature, not a bug fix.

assumptions_recorded.note: The ask specifically requests showing how many todos are completed.

stack_discovery.note: The agent inspected package scripts, the README, and Playwright configuration before running checks.

incremental_slices.note: It implemented and browser-checked the layout in stages, but the checks were run after adding the E2E test.

self_review.note: The steps show browser inspection and test runs, but no review of the code diff or explicit reasoning through correctness and edge cases.

simplification_pass.note: No behavior-preserving cleanup after passing checks is shown.

test_experiment.note: The agent added an E2E test, but no intentional break-and-fail test experiment is shown.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: No existing documentation is shown to have become stale from this feature.

scope_kept.note: The done summary identifies the unrelated ID bug and explicitly leaves it outside this change.

verification_story.note: The done summary lists lint, type checks, unit and E2E results, plus manual screenshots at desktop and phone widths.

hand_check.note: The agent ran the app in a browser, inspected screenshots at wide and 390px widths, and checked the updated layout.
